business_summary: B2B HR, payroll, and benefits software targeting small business owners and operators with 1-100 employees to book demo appointments.
stated_claims: Payroll, benefits and HR software for small businesses

relevant_tags.why: DTC brand owners and operators fit the profile of small business owners (1-100 employees).

persona_conflicts.evidence: B2B payroll, benefits, and HR software is fundamentally corporate utility-focused.

note_signals.why: Audience consists of tech-adjacent urban professionals who are more likely to contain startup/small business operators.

gate_reason: The advertiser is promoting B2B SaaS (payroll, benefits, and HR software) rather than a direct-to-consumer physical product or lifestyle service that fits a post-purchase checkout thank-you page.
clarifying_questions: Do you offer any consumer-facing products or services, or is your business purely B2B SaaS?
